messages:
joanne: Heads up — while following the onboarding quickstart I hit a couple broken links and a 403 image. started at step 4 and stopped.
sam: which links? can you paste the URLs?
joanne: sure — main guide: https://kb.redwood.ai/onboard/quickstart
joanne: step 4 'set up SSH' link -> https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/ssh-setup returns 404
joanne: image -> https://cdn.redwood.ai/images/onboard/setup-2.png returns 403
sam: ah ok. might be a sync issue with the CDN or the repo moved :thinking_face:
joanne: repro steps: follow Quickstart -> run `ssh-keygen -t ed25519` -> click the "SSH setup" link
joanne: small note: the Mac M1 instructions also reference `brew install open-ssh` which looks wrong
maria: tagging docs team — I can take ownership of this doc. will open a PR for the broken link and add the M1 note. :+1:
maria: PR will be against `main` in docs repo, will attempt to fix the CDN path too if I can reproduce locally
joanne: awesome, thanks! would you mind adding a short note about expected file perms on Linux as well? some users trip on that
maria: noted. will add `chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` example
aj: can you @me on the PR? I'll do a quick review this afternoon. :eyes:
maria: yep — PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/482 (WIP)
joanne: left one more nit — anchor in the Quickstart TOC points to `#docker-resources` but the header is `## Docker resources` (case/space mismatch?)
sam: that explains the orphan anchor scanner noise we saw earlier
docs-bot: linkchecker scan: found 3 failing links in `/onboard/quickstart` (2 broken, 1 CDN 403). created issue #1258 in infra-triage.
maria: thanks bot. I'll reference issue #1258 in the PR description and ping infra for the CDN 403.
aj: quick reminder — if the fix touches redirects, please add a short changelog entry in the docs release notes
maria: will do. aiming to have PR ready by EOD and then ping reviewers
joanne: thanks everyone. small async win — saves a support ticket later :thumbsup:
sam: follow-up: if infra needs a hand reproing the CDN 403, I can spare 30m tomorrow to pair
maria: great — I'll coordinate with infra in the issue. pinging @infra on the issue now
aj: sounds good. once merged, can we add a smoke test in the docs CI to catch image 403s automatically? :thinking_face:
maria: adding a follow-up task in the PR to propose CI check
joanne: perfect. closing this thread once PR merges.
